header: ROUND 13 - Real Repo: pydantic #12424 - exclude_if fields wrongly required in serialization schema
sub: Real closed bug (fixed upstream by PR #12430). Both models had to infer that exclude_if must also respect the json_schema_serialization_defaults_required config flag - the hidden maintainer test asserts both variants. Validation subagent DID solve it, so it was solvable from issue + code.

verdict_notes: A double miss - the only round where NEITHER model passed the hidden test. Both fixed the reported case (exclude_if field no longer required) but neither inferred the interaction with the defaults-required config flag that the maintainers also pinned. Both kept all 525 regression tests green. On the double-0 tie, Opus takes the round on wall clock (92.2s vs 134.8s).
